news.title: Who Sees Themselves as Working Class?
news.summary_en: Most Americans think of themselves as working class, and Republicans are more likely to do so than Democrats.

news.title: International views of the U.S. and its president are increasingly correlated
news.summary_en: During Joe Biden’s presidency, as well as during Donald Trump’s first term, there was a much weaker relationship between views of the U.S. and confidence in its president.
